rationale: Two actionable findings: (1) the new test suite omits boundary tests for totalCount=0 and null, leaving a regression gap on the truthiness guard; (2) the branch name 'epmcdme-8477-fix-semantic-headings' does not follow the required EPMCDME-XXXX_short-description pattern (Tekton enforced). Three findings deferred as pre-existing or out-of-scope: the page-level h1 absence (the empty-state <h2> already existed before this diff under the same page with no h1 — this diff does not introduce the problem), null totalCountInfo string computation, and negative-count guard edge case. Acceptance lens not run: no story/spec artifact — no-spec round.

standards_review.notes: Branch 'epmcdme-8477-fix-semantic-headings' uses lowercase and hyphens throughout. Required pattern: 'EPMCDME-XXXX_short-description' (uppercase ticket prefix, underscore between ticket ID and description). Tekton CI enforces this pattern. Note: the user explicitly chose this branch name at the Stage 0 HITL prompt.
Commit message 'EPMCDME-8477: Mark assistant count headings as semantic h2' matches the required 'EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence' format.
No security concerns. Change is pure HTML semantics (div to h2) with no data handling, auth, or external interaction.
Guide file not found in the guides directory. Lint and typecheck are covered by the qa-gates stage.

findings.problem: The new test suite covers only positive totalCount values (1, 3, 5). The guard '{totalCount && ...}' is falsy for both 0 and null, so neither must render a heading — but no test asserts this. If a future refactor loosens the guard (e.g., to '{totalCount !== null && ...}'), totalCount=0 would silently start rendering '0 ASSISTANTS' with no regression test catching it.
findings.impact: Regression risk on the core boundary condition: when the heading renders versus when it is suppressed.
findings.recommendation: Add one test: it('does not render a count heading when totalCount is 0', () => { render(<AssistantGrid {...baseProps} assistants={[stubAssistant]} totalCount={0} isTemplate={false} />); expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { level: 2 })).toBeNull(); })

findings.problem: Branch name 'epmcdme-8477-fix-semantic-headings' is all-lowercase with hyphens throughout. The project standard per git-workflow.md requires 'EPMCDME-XXXX_short-description' (uppercase ticket prefix, underscore separating ticket ID from the description slug). Tekton CI enforces the pattern.
findings.impact: Branch may fail CI branch-name validation when a merge request is opened. The user explicitly chose this branch name at the Stage 0 HITL prompt, so this may be an intentional deviation.
findings.recommendation: Rename branch to 'EPMCDME-8477_fix-semantic-headings' before creating the MR, or confirm with the team that lowercase branch names are accepted.

deferred.description: No page-level h1 precedes the h2 count heading on AssistantsListPage — potential WCAG 1.3.1 heading hierarchy gap. Pre-existing: the empty-state <h2> already existed before this diff under the same page with no h1. This diff does not introduce the problem; it simply adds a second h2 path. Broader heading hierarchy should be addressed in a separate accessibility audit ticket.
Negative totalCount values are truthy and would render an invalid '-1 ASSISTANTS' heading. Pre-existing guard behavior, not introduced by this diff. Extremely unlikely from the internal API.
totalCountInfo string is computed unconditionally even when totalCount is null, producing 'null ASSISTANTS'. Never rendered due to guard, but a latent correctness issue. Pre-existing.

dismissed.description: Blind reviewer questioned whether the test assertion string '5 ASSISTANTS' matches the actual rendered text. Dismissed: AssistantGrid.tsx line 51-52 uses pluralize(totalCount, 'assistant').toUpperCase(), so the output is '5 ASSISTANTS' — the assertion is correct.
